title: Gemena civic organizations march over insecurity and submit memorandum to state authorities
location: Rond-point Petrobaje along Avenue de l'Hôpital via central market to Governorate administrative building, Gemena, Sud-Ubangi
size_reported: No numerical or clearly thresholded same-site count reported; article names civil-society participants but not group size.

action.summary: Actualité.cd reports people walked a route and read/deposited a memorandum at the governorate.

demand.summary: Memorandum asked the President to remove two magistrates, remove a military regiment accused of insecurity, arrest implicated troops, and urged provincial/city authorities to secure residents or resign.

threshold.summary: No number or supportable same-site threshold in opened report.

location.summary: Route and destination given; governorate memorandum was addressed to the Head of State.

state_response.summary: Separate search-only follow-up reports a curfew decree on Dec9; causal connection and accommodation of march demands remain unestablished.

title: LIZADEEL and civil-society march in Gemena for implementation of free primary education
location: Gemena, Sud-Ubangi; route/site boundaries not reported.
size_reported: No participant count; article mentions human-rights NGOs, parents and teachers.

action.summary: Actualité.cd reports organizations, parents and teachers gathered and marched in the streets for Human Rights Day.

demand.summary: LIZADEEL demanded provincial implementation of constitutionally guaranteed free education and removal of fees imposed on parents to pay new-unit teachers.

threshold.summary: No same-site headcount in report; group composition alone does not establish ≥50.

state_response.summary: Sud-Ubangi vice-governor told marchers the government would instruct the education minister to ensure the memorandum was respected and investigate funds; accommodation coded as reported commitment pending review.
